history.summary: A brand-new (2026 TOP) CDL/MCL D15 project 670m from the new TEL Tanjong Katong station, with the listing's $2,549 psf sitting ~7% below the $2,746 project median — a sub-median entry on a quality launch. But the 11.3% CAGR carries explicit new-launch bias, the compact 667 sqft unit costs $1.7M at a steep absolute psf, and most price-in already happened. Honest Neutral.
history.rating_rationale: Quality is not the issue — CDL/MCL are top-tier developers, 638 units, prime D15 Katong, 670m to the new Thomson-East Coast Line Tanjong Katong station, and at $2,549 psf the listing is meaningfully under the $2,746 median (motivated/early sub-sale). The investment caution is value: the flagged has_new_launch_bias means the 11.3% figure reflects developer-led launch-to-now pricing, not a repeatable resale trend (rubric warns against importing this). At $2,549 psf for a small 667 sqft 2BR, much of the East Coast/TEL upside is already in the price; entry is high-absolute ($1.7M) and yield is thin at this psf. Good building, fully-priced entry.
red_flags: Appreciation flagged as new-launch biased (11.3%) — not a resale-validated trend; do not extrapolate

history.summary: Brand-new (TOP 2026) 990sqft 3BR at $2.65M / $2677 psf in a 638-unit CDL-MCL development near Tanjong Katong MRT (TEL). The headline 11.3%/yr figure is new-launch-biased and reflects developer pricing, not realizable resale momentum — Q2 2026 transactions show only ~4.8% uplift since launch. Quality D15 location, but you are buying at the top of the price curve.
history.rating_rationale: This is a high-quality project (CDL/MCL, 638 units, TEL access, prime D15 Katong) but priced as a new launch with little margin for investment upside. Asking $2677 psf is near the $2746 launch median, and only ~4.8% appreciation has materialized since launch — the 11.3% URA figure is flagged new-launch-biased and should not be taken as forward resale growth. At $2.65M for a compact 990sqft 3BR, entry PSF is rich, the lowest MMR (785) and score (785/1000) in the batch reflect that, and a wave of nearby D15 new-launch supply (Grand Dunman, Continuum, etc.) will compete on resale. Good home, mediocre 5-7yr investment entry point — Neutral.
red_flags: New-launch pricing: ~$2677 psf with only ~4.8% post-launch uplift, little upside left
11.3% URA rate is new-launch-biased — not a reliable forward indicator
990sqft is compact for a $2.65M 3BR; rich PSF caps yield
Heavy competing D15 new-launch supply (Grand Dunman, Continuum) pressures resale
catalysts: Thomson-East Coast Line (Tanjong Katong) and prime D15 Katong address
Reputable CDL/MCL developer, large 638-unit development with deep liquidity
Long fresh 99yr lease and brand-new condition
